metadata.article_title: Joinder of parties liable on same contract.

article.title: Joinder of parties liable on same contract.
article.content: The plaintiff may, at his option, join as parties to the same suit all or any of the persons severally, or jointly and severally, liable on any one contract, including parties to bills of exchange, hundis and promissory notes.
article.html:
6Joinder of parties liable on same contract.

Order 1, Rule 6

The plaintiff may, at his option, join as parties to the same suit all or any of the persons severally, or jointly and severally, liable on any one contract, including parties to bills of exchange, hundis and promissory notes.
